sloka: लङ्कामपि पुरा नीतामशोकवनिकां गताम् ।रक्षसां वशमापन्नां कथं रामो न कुत्सते ।। ७.४३.१८ ॥
transliteration: laṅkāmapi purā nītāmaśokavanikāṁ gatām ।rakṣasāṁ vaśamāpannāṁ kathaṁ rāmo na kutsate ।। 7.43.18 ॥

translations.english: How can Rāma not despise her, who was formerly taken to Laṅkā, went to the Aśoka grove, and fell under the control of Rākṣasas?
